steps.name: Harden the runner (Audit all outbound calls)
Get target version

set -ue
CURRENT_VERSION=$(grep 'module github.com/argoproj/argo-cd' go.mod | awk '{print $2}' | sed 's/.*\/v//')

Run codegen

git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

  --head "$BRANCH" \
  --body "$(cat <<'PREOF'

Next steps:
- [ ] Merge this PR
- [ ] Add an upgrade guide to the docs for this version
PREOF
)"

pipelines.name: Cherry Pick Single

steps.name: Harden the runner (Audit all outbound calls)
Configure Git
steps.run:
git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

steps.name: Cherry pick commit
steps.run:
set -e

MERGE_COMMIT="${INPUTS_MERGE_COMMIT_SHA}"
TARGET_BRANCH="release-${INPUTS_VERSION_NUMBER}"

echo "🍒 Cherry-picking commit $MERGE_COMMIT to branch $TARGET_BRANCH"

# Check if target branch exists
if ! git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/origin/$TARGET_BRANCH"; then
  echo "❌ Target branch '$TARGET_BRANCH' does not exist"
  exit 1
fi

# Create new branch for cherry-pick
CHERRY_PICK_BRANCH="cherry-pick-${INPUTS_PR_NUMBER}-to-${TARGET_BRANCH}"

git checkout -b "$CHERRY_PICK_BRANCH" "origin/$TARGET_BRANCH"

# Perform cherry-pick
if git cherry-pick -m 1 "$MERGE_COMMIT"; then
  echo "✅ Cherry-pick successful"

  # Extract Signed-off-by from the cherry-pick commit
  SIGNOFF=$(git log -1 --pretty=format:"%B" | grep -E '^Signed-off-by:' || echo "")

  # Push the new branch. Force push to ensure that in case the original cherry-pick branch is stale, 
  # that the current state of the $TARGET_BRANCH + cherry-pick gets in $CHERRY_PICK_BRANCH.
  git push "https://x-access-token:${APP_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" -f "$CHERRY_PICK_BRANCH"

  # Save data for PR creation
  echo "branch_name=$CHERRY_PICK_BRANCH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  {
    echo "signoff<<EOF"
    echo "$SIGNOFF"
    echo "EOF"
  } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "target_branch=$TARGET_BRANCH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "❌ Cherry-pick failed due to conflicts"
  git cherry-pick --abort
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Create Pull Request
steps.run:
# Create cherry-pick PR
TITLE="${PR_TITLE} (cherry-pick #${INPUTS_PR_NUMBER} for ${INPUTS_VERSION_NUMBER})"
BODY=$(cat <<EOF
Cherry-picked ${PR_TITLE} (#${INPUTS_PR_NUMBER})

${STEPS_CHERRY_PICK_OUTPUTS_SIGNOFF}
EOF
)

gh pr create \
  --title "$TITLE" \
  --body "$BODY" \
  --base "${STEPS_CHERRY_PICK_OUTPUTS_TARGET_BRANCH}" \
  --head "${STEPS_CHERRY_PICK_OUTPUTS_BRANCH_NAME}"

# Comment on original PR
gh pr comment ${INPUTS_PR_NUMBER} \
  --body "🍒 Cherry-pick PR created for ${INPUTS_VERSION_NUMBER}: #$(gh pr list --head ${STEPS_CHERRY_PICK_OUTPUTS_BRANCH_NAME} --json number --jq '.[0].number')"

steps.name: Comment on failure
steps.run:
gh pr comment ${INPUTS_PR_NUMBER} \
  --body "❌ Cherry-pick failed for ${INPUTS_VERSION_NUMBER}. Please check the [workflow logs](https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}) for details."

with.files_yaml:
backend:
  - '**'
  - '!ui/**'
  - '!**.md'
  - '!**/*.md'
  - '!docs/**'
  - '!VERSION'
  - '!manifests/**'
  - 'ui/embed.go'
  - 'ui/dist/app/gitkeep'
  - 'ui/dist/app/assets/images/resources/.gitkeep'
# The e2e suite is the backend set minus paths that provably cannot change its
# outcome. Keep this list conservative: a false negative here means a regression
# ships untested, while a false positive only costs CI time.
e2e:
  - '**'
  - '!ui/**'
  - '!**.md'
  - '!**/*.md'
  - '!docs/**'
  # Workflows other than this one never execute during the e2e job. This file is
  # re-included below because it defines the job itself.
  - '!.github/**'
  - '.github/workflows/ci-build.yaml'
  # Consumed by docs generation and the notifications engine's own unit tests.
  - '!notifications_catalog/**'
  # Sample manifests for users; never applied by the e2e fixtures.
  - '!examples/**'
  # Renovate/Sonar/ownership metadata, not build or runtime inputs.
  - '!renovate-presets/**'
  - '!renovate.json'
  - '!sonar-project.properties'
  - '!CODEOWNERS'
  - '!OWNERS'

steps.name: Compute the e2e shard split
steps.run:
set -eu
# awk rather than `seq -s,`: BSD seq appends a trailing separator and GNU does
# not, which would emit invalid JSON on a non-GNU runner.
list=$(awk -v n="${SHARD_COUNT}" 'BEGIN { printf "["; for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) printf "%s%d", (i > 1 ? "," : ""), i; printf "]" }')
echo "count=${SHARD_COUNT}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "list=${list}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

pipelines.name: Refresh e2e shard weights

steps.name: Harden the runner (Audit all outbound calls)
Download e2e timings
steps.run:
set -eu
shards=$(yq '.jobs.changes.steps[] | select(.id == "shards") | .env.SHARD_COUNT' .github/workflows/ci-build.yaml)
count=$(hack/e2e-shard-weights-download.sh "${RUNNER_TEMP}/runs" "${shards}" "${MAX_RUNS}" "${DAYS}")
if [ "${count}" -lt "${MIN_RUNS}" ]; then
  echo "::warning::Only ${count} builds with e2e timings in the last ${DAYS} days, need ${MIN_RUNS}; the shard weights are left unchanged."
fi
echo "shards=${shards}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "count=${count}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Open, update or close the refresh PR
steps.run:
set -eu
report="${RUNNER_TEMP}/report.md"
pr=$(gh pr list -R "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --head "${BRANCH}" --base master --state open \
  --json number,headRepositoryOwner \
  --jq "map(select(.headRepositoryOwner.login == \"${GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER}\")) | .[0].number // empty")

if [ ! -f "${report}" ]; then
  if [ -n "${pr}" ]; then
    gh pr close -R "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" "${pr}" --delete-branch \
      --comment "The e2e timings of the last ${DAYS} days no longer justify a change to the shard weights."
  fi
  exit 0
fi

weights=test/e2e/shard-weights.txt
cp "${weights}" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/weights.txt"
remote="https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git"
if [ -n "${pr}" ]; then
  git fetch --quiet --depth=1 "${remote}" "${BRANCH}"
  git checkout --quiet --force -B "${BRANCH}" FETCH_HEAD
  cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/weights.txt" "${weights}"
else
  git checkout --quiet -B "${BRANCH}"
fi

if git diff --quiet -- "${weights}"; then
  echo "PR #${pr} already has these weights"
else
  git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
  git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
  git add "${weights}"
  git commit --signoff -m "chore: refresh e2e shard weights"
  git push --force "${remote}" "HEAD:refs/heads/${BRANCH}"
fi

if [ -n "${pr}" ]; then
  gh pr edit -R "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" "${pr}" --body-file "${report}"
else
  gh pr create -R "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --base master --head "${BRANCH}" \
    --title "chore: refresh e2e shard weights" --body-file "${report}"
fi

  ${INPUTS_QUAY_IMAGE_NAME} \

  echo -n "${str}",;done | sed 's/,$//')

  ${INPUTS_QUAY_IMAGE_NAME} \

  ${INPUTS_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME}; do
  echo -n "${tag}" | awk -F ":" '{print $1}' -;done)

  echo 'SIGNING_TAGS<<EOF' >> $GITHUB_ENV

steps.name: Sign container images

  -a "repo=${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
  -a "workflow=${GITHUB_WORKFLOW}" \

prepare-release.name: Automatically generate version and manifests on ${{ inputs.TARGET_BRANCH }}

steps.name: Harden the runner (Audit all outbound calls)
Check if TARGET_VERSION is well formed.
steps.run:
set -xue
# Target version must not contain 'v' prefix
if echo "${INPUTS_TARGET_VERSION}" | grep -e '^v'; then
  echo "::error::Target version '${INPUTS_TARGET_VERSION}' should not begin with a 'v' prefix, refusing to continue." >&2
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Create VERSION information
steps.run:
set -ue
echo "Bumping version from $(cat VERSION) to ${INPUTS_TARGET_VERSION}"
echo "${INPUTS_TARGET_VERSION}" > VERSION

steps.name: Update go.mod gitops-engine version to release tag
steps.run:
set -xue
# Update the require line to reference the gitops-engine tag that will be created at release time.
# Derive the major version from TARGET_VERSION so this works across future major bumps.
GE_VERSION="v${{ inputs.TARGET_VERSION }}"
MAJOR=$(echo "${{ inputs.TARGET_VERSION }}" | cut -d. -f1)
GE_MODULE="github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/gitops-engine/v${MAJOR}"
sed -i "s|${GE_MODULE} v[^ ]*|${GE_MODULE} ${GE_VERSION}|" go.mod

steps.name: Generate new set of manifests
steps.run:
set -ue
make install-codegen-tools-local
make manifests-local VERSION=${INPUTS_TARGET_VERSION}
git diff

steps.name: Generate version compatibility table
steps.run:
git stash
bash hack/update-supported-versions.sh
git add -u .
git stash pop

steps.name: Create pull request
steps.run:
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
BRANCH="update-version-$(date +%s)"
git checkout -b "$BRANCH"
git add -A
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "No changes to commit"
  exit 0
fi
git commit --signoff -m "Bump version to ${TARGET_VERSION}"
git push "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" "$BRANCH"
gh pr create \
  --title "chore: bump version to ${TARGET_VERSION} on ${TARGET_BRANCH} branch" \
  --body "Updating VERSION and manifests to ${TARGET_VERSION}" \
  --head "$BRANCH" \
  --base "${TARGET_BRANCH}" \
  --label release

pipelines.name: Publish ArgoCD Release

steps.name: Harden the runner (Audit all outbound calls)
Setup variables
steps.run:
set -xue
# Fetch all tag information
git fetch --prune --tags --force

LATEST_RELEASE_TAG=$(git -c 'versionsort.suffix=-rc' tag --list --sort=version:refname | grep -v '-' | tail -n1)

PRE_RELEASE=false
# Check if latest tag is a pre-release
if echo ${GITHUB_REF_NAME} | grep -E -- '-rc[0-9]+$';then
  PRE_RELEASE=true
fi

IS_LATEST=false
# Ensure latest release tag matches github.ref_name
if [[ $LATEST_RELEASE_TAG == "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" ]];then
  IS_LATEST=true
fi
echo "is_pre_release=$PRE_RELEASE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "is_latest_release=$IS_LATEST" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

# Calculate configuration with defaults
ENABLE_FORK_RELEASES="${VARS_ENABLE_FORK_RELEASES:-false}"
IMAGE_NAMESPACE="${VARS_IMAGE_NAMESPACE:-argoproj}"
IMAGE_REPOSITORY="${VARS_IMAGE_REPOSITORY:-argocd}"

echo "enable_fork_releases=$ENABLE_FORK_RELEASES" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

echo "image_namespace=$IMAGE_NAMESPACE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "image_repository=$IMAGE_REPOSITORY" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "quay_image_name=quay.io/$IMAGE_NAMESPACE/$IMAGE_REPOSITORY:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "provenance_image=quay.io/$IMAGE_NAMESPACE/$IMAGE_REPOSITORY" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

ALLOW_FORK_RELEASE=false
if [[ "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER" != "argoproj" && "$ENABLE_FORK_RELEASES" == "true" && "$IMAGE_NAMESPACE" != "argoproj" && "${GITHUB_REF}" == refs/tags/* ]]; then
  ALLOW_FORK_RELEASE=true
fi
echo "allow_fork_release=$ALLOW_FORK_RELEASE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

steps.name: Set environment variables for ldflags
steps.run:
echo "KUBECTL_VERSION=$(go list -m k8s.io/client-go | head -n 1 | rev | cut -d' ' -f1 | rev)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
echo "GIT_TREE_STATE=$(if [ -z "`git status --porcelain`" ]; then echo "clean" ; else echo "dirty"; fi)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

steps.name: Generate subject for provenance
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

hashes=$(echo $ARTIFACTS | jq --raw-output '.[] | {name, "digest": (.extra.Digest // .extra.Checksum)} | select(.digest) | {digest} + {name} | join("  ") | sub("^sha256:";"")' | base64 -w0)
if test "$hashes" = ""; then # goreleaser < v1.13.0
  checksum_file=$(echo "$ARTIFACTS" | jq -r '.[] | select (.type=="Checksum") | .path')
  hashes=$(cat $checksum_file | base64 -w0)
fi
echo "hashes=$hashes" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

steps.name: Generate SBOM (spdx)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
pnpm install --dir ./ui --frozen-lockfile
go install github.com/spdx/spdx-sbom-generator/cmd/generator@$SPDX_GEN_VERSION
go install sigs.k8s.io/bom/cmd/bom@$SIGS_BOM_VERSION

generator -p . -o /tmp

pnpm --dir ./ui sbom --sbom-format spdx --prod > /tmp/bom-ui-pnpm.spdx.json

if [[ -n "${DOCKER_IMAGE:-}" ]]; then
  bom generate -o /tmp/bom-docker-image.spdx -i "${DOCKER_IMAGE}"
fi

cd /tmp
shopt -s nullglob
spdx_files=( *.spdx )
shopt -u nullglob
if [[ ${#spdx_files[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "No .spdx files produced under /tmp"
  exit 1
fi
tar -zcf sbom.tar.gz "${spdx_files[@]}" bom-ui-pnpm.spdx.json

steps.name: Generate SBOM hash
steps.run:
# sha256sum generates sha256 hash for sbom.
# base64 -w0 encodes to base64 and outputs on a single line.
# sha256sum /tmp/sbom.tar.gz ... | base64 -w0
echo "hashes=$(sha256sum /tmp/sbom.tar.gz | base64 -w0)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Setup Git author information
steps.run:
set -ue
git config --global user.email 'ci@argoproj.com'
git config --global user.name 'CI'

steps.name: Update stable tag to latest version
steps.run:
git tag -f stable ${GITHUB_REF_NAME}
git push "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" -f stable

steps.name: Tag gitops-engine submodule
steps.run:
set -ue
# Create a path-prefixed tag for gitops-engine
# so downstream consumers can resolve github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/gitops-engine/v3
# https://go.dev/doc/modules/managing-source#multiple-module-source
GE_TAG="gitops-engine/${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
# checkout uses persist-credentials: false, so push with an explicit token URL
REMOTE="https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git"
# checkout with fetch-depth: 0 fetches all tags, so a local lookup is enough
if git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/${GE_TAG}" >/dev/null; then
  echo "Tag ${GE_TAG} already exists; skipping"
else
  git tag "${GE_TAG}" "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}^{}"
  git push "${REMOTE}" "refs/tags/${GE_TAG}:refs/tags/${GE_TAG}"
  echo "Pushed tag ${GE_TAG}"
fi

steps.name: Check to see if VERSION should be updated on master branch
steps.run:
set -xue
SOURCE_TAG=${GITHUB_REF_NAME}
VERSION_REF="${SOURCE_TAG#*v}"
COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
if echo "$VERSION_REF" | grep -E -- '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.0-rc1';then
  VERSION=$(awk 'BEGIN {FS=OFS="."} {$2++; print}' <<< "${VERSION_REF%-rc1}")
  echo "Updating VERSION to: $VERSION"
  echo "UPDATE_VERSION=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
  echo "NEW_VERSION=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
  echo "COMMIT_HASH=$COMMIT_HASH" >> $GITHUB_ENV
else
  echo "Not updating VERSION"
  echo "UPDATE_VERSION=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
fi

steps.name: Create PR to update VERSION on master branch
steps.run:
set -xue
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
BRANCH="update-version-$(date +%s)"
# Make new branch explicitly from master since we're on the release branch
git fetch origin master
git checkout -b "$BRANCH" -f origin/master
# Ensure there is no junk left from the previous steps
git clean -fd
# Update the files
echo ${NEW_VERSION} > VERSION
# Replace the 'project-release: vX.X.X-rcX' line in SECURITY-INSIGHTS.yml
sed -i "s/project-release: v.*$/project-release: v${NEW_VERSION}/" SECURITY-INSIGHTS.yml
# Update the 'commit-hash: XXXXXXX' line in SECURITY-INSIGHTS.yml
sed -i "s/commit-hash: .*/commit-hash: ${COMMIT_HASH}/" SECURITY-INSIGHTS.yml
# Refresh 'last-updated', because the 'project-release' edit above is a
# change this field is required to track. Per the Security Insights v1.0.0
# spec, last-updated is "the date of the last update to SECURITY-INSIGHTS.yml,
# excluding the properties commit-hash and last-reviewed" -- project-release
# is not excluded, so bumping it without bumping last-updated leaves the
# manifest reporting an update date older than its own contents.
# 'last-reviewed' and 'expiration-date' are deliberately NOT touched here:
# they are maintainer attestations ("reviewed by a project maintainer to
# confirm holistic accuracy"), and automating them would assert a review
# that nobody performed.
sed -i "s/last-updated: .*/last-updated: '$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)'/" SECURITY-INSIGHTS.yml
# making commit and PR
git add -A
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "No changes to commit"
  exit 0
fi
git commit --signoff -m "Bump version in master"
git push "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" "$BRANCH"
gh pr create \
  --title "chore: Bump version in master" \
  --body "All images built from master should indicate which version we are on track for." \
  --head "$BRANCH" \
  --base master

make-report-pr.name: Update Snyk report in the docs directory

steps.name: Harden the runner (Audit all outbound calls)
Make pr
steps.run:
pr_branch="snyk-update-$(echo $RANDOM | md5sum | head -c 20)"
git checkout -b "$pr_branch"
git config --global user.email 'ci@argoproj.com'
git config --global user.name 'CI'
git add docs/snyk
git commit -m "[Bot] docs: Update Snyk reports" --signoff
git push --set-upstream origin "$pr_branch"
gh pr create -B master -H "$pr_branch" --title '[Bot] docs: Update Snyk report' --body ''
